verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents publishers sending simulcast or layered (SVC) video, or the relay choosing a layer per subscriber based on bandwidth. The closest item is stream prioritization, where new groups and audio starve old video under congestion. That is a related congestion behavior, not per-subscriber layer adaptation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
